gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans: Structural and striking, Stencilia leaves generous gaps where its curves end, while Noto Sans fills the line with a wide-open c. Over a long passage it stays easy going.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Stencilia opens things with striking, structural capitals. Noto Sans Adlam follows in a plain sans-serif manner, keeping its curve endings well apart so the heading's gaps find an echo below.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-adlam-: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads modern and businesslike, leaving generous space between each curve end and its stem, with little height gap between cases. Stencilia sits above it, striking and structural.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-anatol: Modern lines meet a structural headline here. Over a longer passage, Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs runs along with outward-pointing terminal tips and a tall x-height, while Stencilia stays striking above it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Clean, structural Stencilia strikes first, its curve terminals spaced wide apart. Noto Sans Arabic then settles underneath with a pronounced x-height and wide openings, giving the heading something easy to stand over.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-armeni: Noto Sans Armenian feels approachable, with tall, full lowercase c, s and z and a wide, inviting opening on its round letters. Stencilia does the striking, structural work up top, and the body simply welcomes the eye.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-baline: Striking and structural, Stencilia leaves spacious gaps at its curve terminals. Noto Sans Balinese does the quieter job, giving every curved glyph breathing space and keeping its ascenders short.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Structural, striking shapes sit on top, with Stencilia's curve terminals held generously apart. Noto Sans Bamum moves along below with big open counters, so a long passage feels clean and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-bassa-: Noto Sans Bassa Vah gives the line a dominant midsection and a c with open jaws like a pair of pliers. Noto Sans Bassa Vah against striking, structural Stencilia is the pair's strongest quality: bold shape against sturdy sans.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak reads approachable, its x-height towering like a stubby pencil stroke and its e staying wide open. Stencilia's structural display capitals are the striking counterpart.
